title: Magical Cleaning: Update service coverage caption copy and remove one live photo

requirements.summary: Update the Service Coverage banner caption (visible text) to the exact requested English sentence via i18n, without changing layout or CTA destinations.
acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts`, the English locale string `serviceCoverage.caption` is set to exactly: "Service coverage areas in Ahmedabad and Gandhi Nagar - Professional residential cleaning services including flats, bungalows, offices, and hospitals".
`frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceCoverageBanner.tsx` continues to render the caption from `t.serviceCoverage.caption` below the banner image, and the new sentence is visible on the page.
No CTA destinations or section order/layout are changed as part of this copy update.

file_operations.description: Update the English translation value for `serviceCoverage.caption` to exactly: "Service coverage areas in Ahmedabad and Gandhi Nagar - Professional residential cleaning services including flats, bungalows, offices, and hospitals" (matching punctuation/capitalization). Ensure no other locale strings or unrelated copy is modified.
Confirm the Service Coverage caption remains rendered as visible on-page text below the banner image using `t.serviceCoverage.caption`, without changing section order/layout or any CTA destinations.

requirements.summary: Remove the last Live Photos gallery entry that references the specified generated image so the grid displays one fewer photo and the deleted image is no longer referenced in code.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhotos.tsx` no longer includes the photo object with `src: '/assets/generated/live-ac-water-jet-1.dim_1600x1200.jpg'` in the `livePhotos` array.
The Live Photos grid renders with one fewer photo card than before.
There are no remaining references to `/assets/generated/live-ac-water-jet-1.dim_1600x1200.jpg` in frontend code (so the deleted photo is not rendered anywhere).

file_operations.description: Remove the last object in the `livePhotos` array whose `src` is `/assets/generated/live-ac-water-jet-1.dim_1600x1200.jpg`. Ensure the remaining array order and rendering logic stay the same, resulting in one fewer rendered photo card and no remaining code references to that image path.
